Your wallet’s main address (it starts with 4). Subaddresses (starting with 8) don’t work with monerod.
More cores = faster, but the phone gets hotter and the node slows down.
Pauses mining when the phone runs on battery.
Pause if the phone gets hot
Pauses from 60 °C, resumes as soon as it cools down.

Solo mining is a lottery: a phone has very little chance of finding a block. If it does, the whole reward (about 0.6 XMR) goes to your address. Mining heats the phone, wears the battery and slows down the node. It only runs when the node is synchronized. By default it uses the light mode (about 256 MB of memory) so that Android doesn’t close the app.
5 to 10 times faster, but uses about 2.3 GB of memory and takes about 30 s to prepare. If the app closes by itself, turn this option off.

So that the node is not stopped.
Auto Blocker protects the phone against apps installed outside the Play Store. You can turn it back on after an update.
Without them, the phone may stop the node and block updates.
The update is blocked by Samsung’s Auto Blocker. Turn it off in Security and privacy, then try again.
